title: LTE OFDM Demodulator
text: Demodulate time-domain OFDM samples and return LTE resource grid, 5 inputs, 3 outputs, {Rounding Method} sets Rounding mode for internal fixed-point calculations; {NDLRB source} sets the source of NDLRB, {NDLRB} sets the number of downlink resource blocks, {Cyclic prefix source} sets the source of cyclic prefix, {Cyclic prefix type} sets the type of cyclic, {CP fraction} sets the percent of cyclic prefix to remove, {Remove DC subcarrier} sets the exclude or include DC subcarrier, {Enable reset input port} sets the reset signal, {Input data sample rate} sets the input sample rate Use maximum input data sample and {Divide butterfly outputs by two} sets the divide FFT butterfly outputs by two. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: valid
ports.summary: Indicates valid input data Boolean scalar

params.name: NDLRB source
params.values: Source of NDLRB Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Cyclic prefix source
params.values: Source of cyclic prefix type Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Cyclic prefix type
params.values: Type of cyclic prefix Normal (default) | Extended

params.name: CP fraction
params.values: Percent of cyclic prefix to remove 0.55 (default) | value from 0 to 1

params.name: Remove DC subcarrier
params.values: Exclude or include DC subcarrier off (default) | on

params.name: Input data sample rate
params.values: Input sample rate Use maximum input data sample rate (default) | Match input data sample rate to NDLRB

params.name: Divide butterfly outputs by two
params.values: Divide FFT butterfly outputs by two off (default) | on

params.name: Rounding Method
params.values: Rounding mode for internal fixed-point calculations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Zero
